_comment: A READ-ONLY QPI flash serving preloaded firmware (gpu-eda/Jacquard#222). Reuses the tests/qspi_psram DUT unchanged: it enters QPI (0x35), quad-writes 0xA5 to addr 0x01, then quad-reads addr 0x01 and asserts rdata == 0xA5. fw/ro_flash.bin already holds 0xA5 at addr 0x01, so the write is redundant — a correct read-only QPI part passes on the preloaded content alone. read_dummy_cycles is set explicitly because flash_ram_params defaults it off `writable` too (src/sim/cosim/mod.rs), which would otherwise confound the QPI-entry bug with a dummy-cycle mismatch.
